definition: See Speculative Decoding — an inference technique using a fast draft model to propose tokens later verified by the target model.
details: The term is sometimes used interchangeably with speculative decoding in discussions of LLM serving infrastructure optimization.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is Speculative Execution (in LLM serving).
